STEP 5 - REGIONAL DESCRIPTORS
========================================

Descriptors:
Area
Perimeter
Compactness
Circularity
Eccentricity
Convex Hull Area
Solidity
Hu Moments 1-7

Compactness = P^2 / (4*pi*A)
Circularity = 4*pi*A / P^2
Solidity = Area / Convex Hull Area

Convex hull construction:
The convex hull is calculated from the corners of foreground pixels using the monotonic chain algorithm and the shoelace formula.
